$comment: The git hooks modules can bring; each goes to .githooks/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from: `install` (a command; it runs when a path in `output` is missing, and those paths go when no module needs the entry any more), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits). An entry with none of these is written by another entry's `install` (listed in its `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

pre-push.describe: runs `npm run verify`; the push is cancelled if it fails.

commit-msg.describe: checks the commit message with commitlint.
